description: Latest TON masterchain block: workchain, shard, seqno and block hashes. Use when: checking that the network (or your endpoint) is alive and synced, or when you need the current block height. Returns: workchain, shard, seqno, rootHash/fileHash in base64. Tip: masterchain produces a block roughly every 3 seconds — if seqno does not grow between calls, the liteserver is lagging.
name: get_masterchain_info
title: Masterchain info
